Du ir dar vienas.
Two and one more.
In the family grow three children.

Tiek, kiek kojų turi stalas.
As many as legs a table has.
By the table stand four chairs.

Tiek, kiek pirštų ant vienos rankos.
As many as fingers on one hand.
The sister has five books.

Tiek, kiek musė turi kojų.
As many as a fly has legs.
She bought six apples.

Tiek, kiek dienų savaitėje.
As many as days in a week.
The child sleeps seven hours.

Du kartus po keturis.
Two times four.
He works eight hours.

Tris kartus po tris.
Three times three.
In the class sit nine pupils.

Tiek, kiek pirštų ant dviejų rankų.
As many as fingers on two hands.
In the school work ten teachers.

Dešimt kartų po dešimt.
Ten times ten.
In the book there are a hundred pages.

Dešimt kartų po šimtą.
Ten times a hundred.
In the village live a thousand people.

Žodis apie save, kai kalbi.
A word about yourself when you speak.
I live in Vilnius.

Žodis apie žmogų, su kuriuo kalbi.
A word about the person with whom you speak.
Do you want coffee?

Žodis apie vyrą arba berniuką.
A word about a man or a boy.
He works in a hospital.

Žodis apie moterį arba mergaitę.
A word about a woman or a girl.
She works in a school.

Žodis apie save ir kitą žmogų kartu.
A word about yourself and another person together.
We live in Kaunas.

Žodis apie žmones, su kuriais kalbi, arba mandagiai apie vieną.
A word about the people you are talking to, or politely about one.
Where do you live?

Žodis apie du ar daugiau vyrų arba apie vyrus ir moteris.
A word about two or more men, or about men and women.
They travel to Kaunas.

Toks, kuris daug reiškia žmogui.
One that means a lot to a person.
Tomorrow we have an important meeting.

Sakyti, ką žmonės turi daryti šalyje.
To say what people must do in the country.
The president rules the country.

Ilgai galvoti ir rasti, ką daryti su sunkiu klausimu.
To think for a long time and find what to do with a difficult question.
We are solving a difficult problem.

Žiūrėti, kad kas nors būtų sveikas ir gyvas.
To watch that someone is healthy and alive.
Parents protect their children.

Dėti daiktus į savo vietas namuose.
To put things in their places at home.
The sister tidies her room.

Toks, kuris padarė blogą dalyką.
One who did a bad thing.
The boy feels guilty for the mistake.

Toks, kuris yra pačioje pabaigoje.
One that is at the very end.
This is the last bus today.

Padėti daiktą ir eiti be jo.
To put a thing down and go without it.
He left the keys at home.

Toks, kuris atrodo kaip kitas daiktas.
One that looks like another thing.
The son is very similar to the father.

Žodis, kuris sako, kaip dažnai kas nors vyksta.
A word which says how often something happens.
Vaistus geriu du kartus per dieną.
The medicine I drink two times per day.

Kai žmogus atvyksta ten, kur jo laukia.
When a person arrives at the place where they are waiting for him.
The friend comes for a visit.

Geltonas, šaltas ir su alkoholiu; jį geria bare.
Yellow, cold and with alcohol; it is drunk in a bar.
The man drinks cold beer.

Raudonas arba baltas, su alkoholiu; jį geria prie vakarienės.
Red or white, with alcohol; it is drunk at dinner.
With fish we drink white wine.

Augalas, kurį valgome; agurkas ar kopūstas.
A plant that we eat; a cucumber or a cabbage.
On the table are fresh vegetables.

Daržovė, kuri auga žemėje; ją verda ir kepa.
A vegetable that grows in the ground; it is boiled and fried.
Mother boils potatoes with salt.

Toks, kuriame yra daug druskos.
One in which there is much salt.
The soup today is too salty.

Toks, kuris teka kaip vanduo; ne kietas.
One that flows like water; not hard.
This porridge is too runny.

Tai, ką gauna žmogus už blogą darbą; pavyzdžiui, kalėjimas.
What a person gets for a bad deed; for example, prison.
The thief got a big punishment.

Žmogus, kurį kviečiame, kai namuose neveikia dušas ar šaldytuvas.
A person whom we call when at home the shower or the fridge does not work.
To the house came the repairman.

Kai bute dažo sienas ir keičia langus.
When in the flat they paint the walls and change the windows.
In the flat there is a big renovation.

Jis auga miške po medžiais; jį renka ir valgo.
It grows in the forest under trees; it is gathered and eaten.
In the forest we found a big mushroom.

Šalis su vyriausybe, įstatymais ir vėliava.
A country with a government, laws and a flag.
Lithuania is a small state.

Tai girdime, kai žmogus kalba ar dainuoja.
This we hear when a person speaks or sings.
She sings in a beautiful voice.

Kieta balta kūno dalis; ją galima susilaužyti.
A hard white part of the body; it can be broken.
The child broke the leg bone.

Tai matome ore, kai kas nors dega.
This we see in the air when something burns.
From the chimney goes smoke.

Žmogus, kuris nuolat yra mieste ar kaime — ten jo namai.
A person who is permanently in a city or a village — his home is there.
City residents travel by buses.

Miestas, kuriame dirba vyriausybė ir prezidentas.
The city where the government and the president work.
Vilnius is Lithuania's capital city.

Dar kartą, kaip ir anksčiau.
One more time, as before.
He again calls mother.

Kai tėvai, gydytojas ar viršininkas leidžia tai daryti.
When parents, a doctor or the boss allow to do it.
Here it is allowed to smoke.
